name: Rusalka Wrath
summary: Infiltrate the Russian mafia as an undercover agent in early 2000s New York. A brutal 2D cinematic shooter set in a living, interactive underworld. Navigate through gritty billiard halls and smoky gambling dens, using lethal slow-motion combat to complete your mission and bring the mafia down.
